name: Collections API
description: Regression tests for the collection endpoints of Requesto's own backend. The suite is self-contained: 'Create Collection' captures the new id and every later request operates on that scratch data, cleaning up after itself. Run with the Local Backend environment against a server started via 'npm run dev' (port 4747) or the CLI in CI.

requests.name: List Collections
requests.documentation:
# List Collections

Lists every collection on the local backend. Expects a 200 and an array response. Later requests operate on the collection created by Create Collection.

requests.name: Create Collection
requests.documentation:
# Create Collection

Creates the collection this suite runs against. The generated id is saved to createdCollectionId for later requests and cleanup.

requests.name: Get Single Collection
requests.documentation:
# Get Single Collection

Fetches the collection by {{createdCollectionId}} and asserts it was stored correctly, with no requests or folders yet.

requests.name: Update Collection
requests.documentation:
# Update Collection

Updates only the description of the created collection and asserts the change round-trips.

requests.name: Duplicate Collection
requests.documentation:
# Duplicate Collection

Copies the created collection. The copy gets a new id, saved to duplicateCollectionId so cleanup can remove it.

requests.name: Export Collection
requests.documentation:
# Export Collection

Exports the created collection and asserts the payload matches it by id and name.

requests.name: Add Request
requests.documentation:
# Add Request

Adds a simple GET /health request to the created collection. The generated id is saved to createdRequestId for the delete test.

requests.name: Delete Request
requests.documentation:
# Delete Request

Deletes the request added above and asserts the operation reports success.

requests.name: Delete Duplicate
requests.documentation:
# Delete Duplicate

Removes the copy created by Duplicate Collection.

requests.name: Delete Collection
requests.documentation:
# Delete Collection

Removes the collection created at the start of the suite, which is the final cleanup step.
